# Faded Barber Shop

> Barber shop at 929 Main St Suite B, Liberty, TX 77575. Fades, beard work, straight razor shaves, kids cuts. Appointments Tuesday to Thursday on TheCut, walk-ins Friday. Phone (936) 402-4637.

## Booking
Appointments run on TheCut at https://book.thecut.co/FadedBarberShop, $39 for 30 minutes,
covering the first service. Tuesday to Thursday are appointment days. Friday is the
walk-in day, first come first served.

## Hours (America/Chicago)
Tue-Thu 10:00-18:00, Fri 10:00-20:00. Sat, Sun and Mon closed.
